say:1:1623412001:1.text: You came for that thing everyone's whispering about, didn't you? I knew it!
say:1:1623412001:1.source_cn: 你也是听说了“那个消息”才来的吧？我就知道！
say:1:1623412001:1.male: You came for that thing everyone's whispering about, didn't you? I knew it!
say:1:1623412001:1.female: You came for that thing everyone's whispering about, didn't you? I knew it!

say:3:1623412002:1.text: Wait, you don't know? Oh, you have to hear this. It's great!
say:3:1623412002:1.source_cn: 哈哈，你不知道吗？你听我说，绝对有趣！
say:3:1623412002:1.male: Wait, you don't know? Oh, you have to hear this. It's great!
say:3:1623412002:1.female: Wait, you don't know? Oh, you have to hear this. It's great!

say:4:1623412004:1.text: You know Barton, the alchemy professor? The bald one... No, I mean, the one who looks wise.
say:4:1623412004:1.source_cn: 教炼金的巴尔顿老师，知道吧？就是那个头发秃……呃，比较...
say:4:1623412004:1.male: You know Barton, the alchemy professor? The bald one... No, I mean, the one who looks wise.
say:4:1623412004:1.female: You know Barton, the alchemy professor? The bald one... No, I mean, the one who looks wise.

say:5:1623412005:1.text: He got his hands on some hair-growth secret! Guess what happened? Head stayed bald, not even one new hair. But his beard? It exploded. It's so thick now it could keep his neck warm in winter!
say:5:1623412005:1.source_cn: 他不知从哪搞来个生发秘方！结果你猜怎么着？头发一根没长...
say:5:1623412005:1.male: He got his hands on some hair-growth secret! Guess what happened? Head stayed bald, not even one new hair. But his beard? It exploded. It's so thick now it could keep his neck warm in winter!
say:5:1623412005:1.female: He got his hands on some hair-growth secret! Guess what happened? Head stayed bald, not even one new hair. But his beard? It exploded. It's so thick now it could keep his neck warm in winter!

say:6:1623412006:1.text: The student in front of you cracks up, bending over and wiping tears from the corners of her eyes. It's obvious she doesn't care whether any of it is true. She's here for the story and the laugh, nothing more.
say:6:1623412006:1.source_cn: 眼前的学生笑得前仰后合，眼泪都快出来了，显然，她并不关...

say:7:1623412007:1.text: She's never stopped to ask what "news" is supposed to be. These things are like pebbles tossed into the ocean to her, not even enough to stir a ripple.
say:7:1623412007:1.source_cn: 她似乎根本没考虑过“新闻”到底是什么，这些事情对他来说...

say:9:1623412003:1.text: News is just gossip with a nicer name, right? As long as it's entertaining, who cares.
say:9:1623412003:1.source_cn: 新闻啊……新闻不就是能让人感兴趣的小道消息吗？
say:9:1623412003:1.male: News is just gossip with a nicer name, right? As long as it's entertaining, who cares.
say:9:1623412003:1.female: News is just gossip with a nicer name, right? As long as it's entertaining, who cares.

choice:2:1:2.text: What do you think of the news the paper's been putting out?
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 你对秘闻社的新闻有什么看法？

choice:2:1:2.female: What do you think of the news the paper's been putting out?
